answer_1.quote: We propose to learn vision-language models to reason with vision specialists. To learn such models, we synthesize a novel large-scale dataset of multimodal reasoning traces grounded on perceptual information. With this data, we fine-tune small vision-language models and perform extensive experiments.
answer_1.outputs: multi-step reasoning traces, visual question answering responses

answer_2.quote: We adapt VLMEvalKit  for our evaluation, where an LLM judge (i.e. GPT-4-turbo) is used to score predictions between 0 and 1 compared to the ground-truth short answers for open-ended questions.
